excerpt: I teach on the topics of civic innovation, data-driven storytelling, and software development at MIT in Cambridge, MA, USA. I also run workshop on the topics of civic innovation and data literacy of social impact around the world. Academic Courses - Data Storytelling Studio – CMS.631/CMS.831 (2016,2015) - Applying Media Technologies: Data Acquisition and Visualization – CMS.622 (2015): (1 month module) - How to Build Software – MAS.500 (2015, 2014, 2013, 2012) (1 month module) - CMS Graduate Workshop: Data Acquisition and Visualization – CMS.950 (2014, 2013) Selected Workshops - From Data to Story – for students the NYU Data Visualization course (Sept 2016) - Making Data Fun – at the Data Literacy Conference (Sept 2016) -
